description: Probability grid over where the simulated evasive subject is, after fixes stop. Trained only on synthetic episodes from the BeliefView 3D simulator.

grid.centre: world xz of the last noisy observation (the model is never run before the first fix; no start position is an input)
grid.layout: grid[channel][row=z][col=x]; cell centre = centre + ((col+0.5-N/2)*cell, (row+0.5-N/2)*cell); prob has the same row-major cell order

channels.name: canopy_cover
channels.description: known map: fraction of the cell under tree canopy (4x4 sub-samples of a 1 m raster)

channels.name: trunk_proximity
channels.description: known map: fraction of the cell within trunk radius + 1.2 m (plausible hiding spots)

channels.name: sensor_visible_now
channels.description: known map + drone pose: cell is inside the camera FOV/range with map line of sight right now

channels.name: sensor_visible_memory
channels.description: same, remembered since the last fix (decays with 25 s time constant); reset on every fix

channels.name: extrapolated_position
channels.description: gaussian blob at last fix + least-squares velocity (last 2 s of fixes) * elapsed

channels.name: reachable_radius
channels.description: 1 - distance from last fix / (6.3 m/s * elapsed + 2 m), clipped to [0, 1]

channels.name: drone_position
channels.description: gaussian blob (sigma 1 cell) at the drone's own position

features.gridQuantisation: values are uint8 codes / 255 (extractor emits exactly these)

output.name: prob
output.interpretation: P(subject is in cell) at the prediction time, given observations so far. Sums to 1 over the grid; subject outside the 128 m grid is not modelled.

region95.statement: Validation-calibrated region: highest-probability cells until mass >= massLevel, with massLevel fitted on the validation split to TARGET 95% coverage. Coverage on other data is measured, not guaranteed (see measured).

developmentTest.split: test (development: seen while tuning, not a pristine holdout)

finalAudit.split: audit (fresh, disjoint, frozen model, never tuned on)

training.architecture: BeliefNet: scalar MLP(13->16) broadcast + 8 spatial channels -> 3x3 conv stem(32) -> 6 residual dilated 3x3 conv+BN+ReLU blocks (dilations [1, 2, 4, 8, 1, 2], Dropout2d 0.15 in training only) -> 1x1 conv -> softmax over 1024 cells
training.loss: cross-entropy on the true cell; AdamW lr 0.001 (OneCycle), weight decay 0.02, dropout 0.15, batch 128, 16 epochs max, early stop (patience 4) on val NLL; best-val-epoch weights shipped

source.generatorCommitNote: parent commit only; the working tree may be dirty/uncommitted, so sourceSha256 (exact file contents) is the authoritative provenance
source.simulator: demo3d/src/sim (TypeScript, Kalman data-collection policy with the coarse start set-up)

limitations: Trained and evaluated only on synthetic simulator episodes of a hand-written evasive subject; says nothing about real people, real drones or real forests.
Training data were collected under the Kalman guidance policy (coarse-start set-up); closed-loop use under learned guidance is a distribution shift.
The drone is set up from a coarse (16 m cell) designated start area; the model receives no start position and is only run after the first noisy fix.
The 95% region is validation-calibrated (target 95%); measured held-out coverage differs and is reported in calibration.region95.measured, not guaranteed.
The grid covers 128 m x 128 m around the last fix; subject mass outside it is not modelled.
Illustrative demo model: no safety, field-performance or clinical claims.
